source.manualTitle: Whirlpool Duet Sport Front-Load Dryer (Job Aid L-79)

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the dryer or disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Electrical Shock Hazard. Disconnect power before accessing.

steps.title: Continue procedure
steps.body: Diagnostic mode entered (saved/active F-xx codes reviewed if applicable). Continue with component tests below.
steps.sourceExcerpt: After diagnostic entry, proceed with OEM component test steps.

steps.title: Enter diagnostic mode
steps.body: Activate diagnostic test mode and advance past saved fault codes. Moisture sensor should already pass TEST #4.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Activate diagnostic test mode and advance past saved fault codes. Moisture sensor should already pass TEST #4.

steps.title: Hold Dryness 5 seconds
steps.body: In diagnostic mode, press and hold the Dryness button 5 seconds. Dryer beeps; current mode (factory default 1) displays.
steps.sourceExcerpt: In diagnostic mode, press and hold the Dryness button 5 seconds. Dryer beeps; current mode (factory default 1) displays.

steps.title: Select longer auto cycle
steps.body: Press Dryness again to cycle display through 2, 3, or 1 (longer auto dry times).
steps.sourceExcerpt: Press Dryness again to cycle display through 2, 3, or 1 (longer auto dry times).

steps.title: Save with START
steps.body: With desired mode flashing, press START to save to EEPROM and exit diagnostics. PAUSE/CANCEL cancels without saving.
steps.sourceExcerpt: With desired mode flashing, press START to save to EEPROM and exit diagnostics. PAUSE/CANCEL cancels without saving.

steps.title: Drying mode updated
steps.oemOutcome: Customer auto-dry aggressiveness increased — stored in MCE EEPROM across power loss.
